title: AutoWorld: Learning Multi-Agent Traffic Simulation with Self-Supervised World Models
abstract: arXiv:2603.28963v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Simulation with realistic traffic agents is essential for validating autonomous driving systems. Existing data-driven simulators learn agent behavior from higher-level abstractions such as 3D bounding boxes and polylines, inferred by upstream perception pipelines. These lossy abstractions discard sensory context that directly shapes agent behavior, limiting the distributional realism that simulation aims to reproduce. To address this limitation, we propose AutoWorld, a traffic simulation framework that grounds agent behavior in raw sensor observations through a self-supervised world model trained on LiDAR occupancy data. Given world model samples, AutoWorld constructs a coarse-to-fine predictive scene context as input to a multi-agent motion generation model. Furthermore, we designed a motion-aware latent supervision objective that enriches AutoWorld's latent representation of scene dynamics. To better exploit this latent space

translated_title: AutoWorld：基于自监督世界模型的多智能体交通仿真学习
translated_abstract: 摘要：使用逼真的交通智能体进行仿真对于验证自动驾驶系统至关重要。现有的数据驱动仿真器从更高级的抽象中学习智能体行为，例如由上游感知流水线推断出的3D边界框和折线。这些有损的抽象丢弃了直接塑造智能体行为的传感上下文，限制了仿真旨在再现的分布真实性。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了AutoWorld，一个交通仿真框架，它通过在LiDAR占用数据上训练的自监督世界模型，将智能体行为建立在原始传感器观测之上。给定世界模型样本，AutoWorld构建由粗到细的预测性场景上下文，作为多智能体运动生成模型的输入。此外，我们设计了一个运动感知的潜在监督目标，丰富了AutoWorld对场景动态的潜在表示。为了更好地利用这一潜在空间……
tldr: 提出了AutoWorld框架，通过基于LiDAR占用数据训练的自监督世界模型，将多智能体交通仿真中的智能体行为建立在原始传感器观测之上，突破了传统有损抽象带来的分布真实性限制。
en_tdlr: AutoWorld is a traffic simulation framework that grounds multi-agent behavior in raw sensor observations through a self-supervised world model trained on LiDAR occupancy data, overcoming the distributional realism limits of lossy abstractions.
